narr: A stationary thunderstorm developed in Linn County, near Marion, Iowa. This thunderstorm formed in a favorable environment for heavy rain, which it led to nearly 6 inches or more in some areas within a few hours. This led to rapid flash flooding within neighborhoods, as Indian Creek came over and out of its banks.
ev: Deep flowing water at 35th Street and Mcgowan Boulevard.
lsr: FLOWING WATER SEVERAL INCHES DEEP COVERING 29TH STREET NEAR 10TH AVENUE.
CORRECTS PREVIOUS FLASH FLOOD REPORT FROM 1 NE MARION. DEEP FLOWING WATER AT 35TH STREET AND MCGOWAN BOULEVARD.
